description: Ambiguous version of the 2026-08-19 call: the caller only says 'I need Saturday instead', which could mean move the existing job or book a second one. Guessing produces either a duplicate or a wrongly deleted job (prompt.ts's own 'Changing an existing booking' section), so the agent must ask which before calling book_appointment, reschedule_appointment or cancel_appointment.

caller.opening: Hey, it's Morgan Blake — I need Saturday instead.
caller.persona: Morgan Blake, who has a water heater repair booked for Wednesday at 88 Birch St, Austin. Deliberately vague on the opening line — never volunteers whether this is the existing job moving or a new one.
caller.goal: Only say it's the same Wednesday job being moved if the agent directly asks whether this is that job or a different one. Do not volunteer that on your own, and do not ask for a second appointment yourself. Once it's clear which job is being changed, accept whichever Saturday window is offered.
